integrity_notes: Complete symbolic global proof with exact rational sign witnesses. A reproducible standalone Python checker supplements rather than substitutes for the proof. Independent verification is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes an order-independent Beer-Lambert optical field, equal optical depths and common low-light quantum-efficiency scale for the two leaf types.
Acclimation, respiration, differential absorption, competition, spectral variation and transient irradiance are not modeled.
Historical priority is provisional; a relevant 1990 multispecies-canopy study was accessible only through its detailed abstract despite lawful-access attempts.

The specific 2001-12-21 motivating-source date is a publisher-provided first-publication date of a directly relevant full-text paper; the foundational Steele paper is dated by its publisher only to April 1962, not to a precisely evidenced day.
title: Unique irradiance crossover and optical-depth limits for two photoinhibited canopy strata
